findings.title: Current handoff claims completion while every execution-plan slice remains pending
findings.evidence: implementation.json reports status "implemented" and acceptance-evidence.json reports all eight slices passed, but execution-plan.json still marks every slice "pending" (lines 32, 64, 93, 123, 155, 187, 217, 246). The required vertical-slice gate explicitly rejects handoff files that do not match the current execution-plan cycle. Running build_evidence_matrix.py with the required plan/handoff inputs therefore cannot establish a trustworthy completed matrix from the current artifacts.
findings.expected_fix: Update the cycle-1 execution plan/checkpoints through the implementation workflow so each completed slice and its evidence are recorded consistently, then regenerate implementation and validation evidence and rerun build_evidence_matrix.py with execution-plan.json and implementation.json.

findings.title: Fidelity evidence provenance contradicts the current-cycle acceptance record
findings.evidence: The responsive/fidelity row says no browser screenshot tool was available and comparison remained code/DOM-only, while the same current-cycle validation directory contains 33 reference/actual screenshot pairs and matrix.json marks every comparison passed. summary.json and the fidelity matrix therefore assert evidence that acceptance-evidence.json explicitly says was not produced. A passing matrix proves path coverage, not that the pairs were actually compared under a reproducible current-cycle workflow.
findings.expected_fix: Regenerate acceptance evidence and the fidelity matrix from one documented current-cycle capture/comparison run. Record the capture command/tool, comparison method or reviewer result, and truthful per-entry status; remove stale contradictory claims.

findings.title: Required route and feature test coverage is incomplete
findings.evidence: The public-web suite has interaction tests for SiteHeader, GiftCatalog, CartView, CustomOrderForm, and EditorView, but no route-render test for any of the six App Router pages, no test for the home-page sections, and no CardCatalog test for /mau-thiep filtering/empty-state/preview behavior. This does not satisfy acceptance criteria 14-15 and the explicit requirement to test route rendering plus risky interactions for each feature; a successful Next build does not replace executable route behavior tests.
findings.expected_fix: Add route-level render/smoke coverage for all six pages and focused /mau-thiep catalog tests covering filter/search empty-state and preview behavior; rerun the complete current-cycle test validation.
